body_lead: Revanth Reddy and Mittal discussed expanding Airtel's digital infrastructure and strengthening collaboration in skill development Hyderabad: Bharti Enterprises chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal said Hyderabad was being considered as the second headquarters of telecom major Bharti Airtel, during his meeting with Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy here on Tuesday. Revanth Reddy and Mittal discussed expanding Airtel's digital infrastructure and strengthening collaboration in skill development.
